evidence: Diagnostics of existing runs; no new run. GCM: one realization each of six years of the Kuo run that forced the box and two years each of the fifteen-level runs, the first two of a spin-up from the fifteen-level restart; the physics by process are single time steps at the end of each 3-day mean, about 60 a quarter in two years and 180 in six, averaged over the six sea cells, so a layer's value carries their noise, which the column's snapshot sum against its exact physics measures; the storage and the column's exact physics come from the 3-day means fitted with four harmonics. CM1: one realization of the sea box's settled third lunar day, its domain means every three hours (about 59 a quarter), each quarter sampled once; the box loses 0.37 mm/day of vapour over that day, more than half above 9 km. The kuo_l10 run is the one the box was forced by; the fifteen-level runs have their own circulation, which no box has met.
reading_rule: bands: the fifteen-level grid's layers at the site, the ground up, edges_m by quarter from the sbm_l15 run's means; every profile is a list over them, the ground up. Vapour in mm/day of water gained by each layer (positive moistening), heat in W/m2 gained (positive warming). GCM: storage from the fitted means; physics_applied (code 40) as the spectral step applies it, physics (code 31) at the grid points; circulation = storage - physics_applied (the transport with the horizontal diffusion, and for heat the adiabatic warming); the processes as PlaSim writes them where the run does (surface, diffusion, large_scale_condensation, convection, dry_adjustment, rain_evaporation), with large-scale condensation also from its heating; column_mm_day: the quarter's exact evaporation, rain and their difference from the means against the snapshots' column sum. The ten-level run's layers are laid on the bands by height, its state on its own layers. CM1: circulation = table + imposed_ascent + nudging (the GCM's forcing), resolved (its own convection and eddies), boundary_layer (the scheme, the surface's evaporation entering at the ground), microphysics (net), rest = storage less them; microphysics_mm_day: the gross processes as vapour (condensation and deposition negative, the evaporations and sublimation positive); state: vapour (g/kg), relative humidity and cloud fraction as domain and mass means, and the condensate held (kg/m2). Quarters by hour angle from noon. ranges: the same summed over the bands 1-4, 5-7 and 8-9 from the ground (about 0-5.2, 5.2-11.8 and 11.8-23.4 km); spread: those sums and the column for each year of the fifteen-level runs and each two-year block of the Kuo run, their differences the measure of the snapshots' noise.
